title: The Star That Swallowed Its Own Planet—And Burped a Warning
hook: A star in Pisces consumed its child world, then emitted a signal that looks like a coded warning to anyone watching.

why_this_can_go_viral: Introduces a new class of star that breaks physics, creating a 'what else is hiding?' mystery.

why_this_can_go_viral: Implies that an unknown intelligence is moving rocks toward or away from Earth, fueling alien intervention fears.

title: The 'Dark Matter Ocean'—An Invisible Sea That Drowns Galaxies in Silence

why_this_can_go_viral: Elicits shock that the military planned to weaponize a planet, pushing the boundaries of human ambition and folly.

title: The 'Signal From Nowhere'—A Transmission That Originated Outside the Observable Universe

title: The 'Dark Matter Parasite'—A Phantom That Steals Energy From Stars Without a Trace

title: The 'Killer Asteroid That Woke Up'—A Dead Rock Suddenly Developed a Magnetic Field
